obd.auto: Connect automatically when the app starts
obd.passed: All good, the adapter delivers data.

kind_note.ble: Bluetooth 4.0 to 5.3, for example Vgate iCar Pro 2S
kind_note.wifi: Adapters with their own Wi-Fi, for example ELM327 WiFi
kind_note.mfi: Adapters certified by Apple, for example OBDLink MX+

kind_unavailable.ble: This device or browser does not support Bluetooth LE.
kind_unavailable.wifi: Only in the app: browsers cannot reach adapters over Wi-Fi.
kind_unavailable.mfi: Only in the app on iPad and iPhone: MFi is an Apple technology.

prepare.plug: Plug the adapter into the OBD2 port, usually below the steering wheel.
prepare.bluetooth: Switch on Bluetooth on the tablet.
prepare.pairing: Do not pair the adapter in the Bluetooth settings of the tablet. Close other OBD apps.
prepare.permission: On the first search the device asks whether CoDriveMate may use Bluetooth: allow it.
prepare.wifi_join: In the Wi-Fi settings of the tablet, join the Wi-Fi of the adapter, usually “WiFi_OBDII” or similar.
prepare.wifi_permission: On the first connection iOS asks for access to the local network: allow it. If it was refused, see “Settings, Privacy, Local Network”.
prepare.wifi_internet: The Wi-Fi of the adapter has no internet. Keep the tablet connected anyway.
prepare.mfi_pair: Pair the adapter in the Bluetooth settings of the iPad.

wizard.choose_text: It is usually called “Vgate”, “IOS-Vlink”, “OBDII” or similar.
wizard.test_text: Checks the way to the engine control unit step by step. This can take up to 30 seconds.
wizard.done_text: The adapter is saved. You find it in the settings.
wizard.choose_text_wifi: Address of the adapter. The default fits most of them.

help.connect: Is the adapter plugged in, nearby and not connected to another app?
help.adapter: The device does not answer like an OBD adapter. Unplug it briefly and try again.
help.voltage: Cannot be measured. No problem if the rest works.
help.ecu: No answer from the car. Is the ignition on?
help.values: The car answers but delivers no values. Start the engine and try again.
help.connect_wifi: Is the tablet in the Wi-Fi of the adapter, are address and port right, and may CoDriveMate access the local network?
help.connect_mfi: Is the adapter connected in the Bluetooth settings and not used by another app?

error.bluetooth: This device or browser does not support Bluetooth LE.
error.unknown: The adapter must be chosen again. In the browser this is needed after every reload.
error.ecu: No answer from the engine control unit. Is the ignition on?
error.permission: Bluetooth is not allowed for CoDriveMate. Please allow it in the device settings.
error.off: Bluetooth is switched off. Please switch it on and try again.

wifi.host_invalid: Please enter a host name or an IPv4 address.
wifi.port_invalid: Please enter a port from 1 to 65535.

mfi.none: No matching adapter connected. Pair it in the Bluetooth settings first.
mfi.failed: The connected devices cannot be listed.

obd.scan_empty: Nothing found. Switch on the ignition and move closer.
